metadata.question: Does the chlorophyll concentration in the equatorial Pacific Ocean (around 140 degrees West) decrease in December 1999 compared to August 1998 ?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: MODIS Aqua ocean color data is not available before 2002. I need to use SeaWiFS data which covers 1997-2010. - Date: August 1998 and December 1999 - Location: Equatorial Pacific Ocean around 140°W (approximately -140° longitude, 0° latitude) 2. Masking strategy: - Ocean color data already has built-in quality flags. I should use the quality band to mask invalid pixels. - Check if chlorophyll data is available for both periods. 3. Logic: - Valid decrease: Aug 1998 chlorophyll > Dec 1999 chlorophyll (both valid numbers) → Answer A - No decrease or increase: Aug 1998 chlorophyll <= Dec 1999 chlorophyll → Answer B - No data for one or both periods → C1 - No valid pixels after masking → C2 - Invalid/null results → C3 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometry - equatorial Pacific around 140°W const region = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-142, -2, -138, 2]); // 2. Data Acquisition - SeaWiFS chlorophyll data const col1998 = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/OCEANDATA/SeaWiFS/L3SMI') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate('1998-08-01', '1998-08-31') .select('chlor_a'); const col1999 = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/OCEANDATA/SeaWiFS/L3SMI') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate('1999-12-01', '1999-12-31') .select('chlor_a'); const size1998 = col1998.size().getInfo(); const size1999 = col1999.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Aug 1998 Images: ${size1998}`); console.log(`Dec 1999 Images: ${size1999}`); if (size1998 === 0 || size1999 === 0) { console.log('Missing data for one or both periods.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Create composite images (mean) const img1998 = col1998.mean(); const img1999 = col1999.mean(); // 4. Check pixel counts const count1998 = img1998.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('chlor_a').getInfo(); const count1999 = img1999.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('chlor_a').getInfo(); console.log(`Aug 1998 Valid Pixels: ${count1998}`); console.log(`Dec 1999 Valid Pixels: ${count1999}`); if (count1998 === 0 || count1999 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 5. Calculate mean chlorophyll const chlor1998 = img1998.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('chlor_a').getInfo(); const chlor1999 = img1999.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('chlor_a').getInfo(); console.log(`Aug 1998 Chlorophyll: ${chlor1998 !== null ? chlor1998.toFixed(4) : 'null'} mg/m³`); console.log(`Dec 1999 Chlorophyll: ${chlor1999 !== null ? chlor1999.toFixed(4) : 'null'} mg/m³`); // 6. Validation and answer if (chlor1998 === null || chlor1999 === null || isNaN(chlor1998) || isNaN(chlor1999) || chlor1998 < 0 || chlor1999 < 0) { console.log('Invalid calculation result.'); console.log('C3'); return; } const decrease = chlor1998 - chlor1999; console.log(`Change: ${decrease.toFixed(4)} mg/m³`); if (chlor1998 > chlor1999) { console.log('Chlorophyll decreased from Aug 1998 to Dec 1999.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Chlorophyll did not decrease.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
